item.title: Sun peeps, but people's pain persists
item.description: A brief spell of sunshine offered some relief in Dhaka on Monday, but the Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) warned that fog is likely to return within hours, keeping winter woes far from over.A mild cold wave continues to sweep across at least nine districts, intensifying hardship for poor and marginalised people. item.title: Reduced import, manipulation cause LPG crisis: LOAB

item.title: Disappearances Commission calls for major reforms

item.title: First-ever JnUCSU polls being held with heightened security
item.description: The Jagannath University Central Students’ Union (JnUCSU) and hall union elections are underway, first time since the institution became a university.The voting started at 9AM on Tuesday and will continue till 3PM without any break.A total of 16,500 students are expected to vote at 39 centres with 178 booths for the JnUCSU election. item.title: Season's lowest temperature 7°C recorded in Rajshahi
item.description: Rajshahi has recorded lowest temperature of 7 degrees Celsius in the current winter season. The temperature was recorded at 6AM on Tuesday.Meanwhile, a mild to moderate cold wave is sweeping over 10 districts of the country.According to the Rajshahi Meteorological Office, the temperature has dropped by 3 degrees Celsius in a single day compared to Monday.
